summary: Retest after changes. Backend 5/5 pytest passing (root, POST/GET /api/contact persistence, invalid email 422, missing fields 422, optional company). Frontend fully validated: window.__lenis is present and used by scrollToId helper; clicking nav-about/nav-services/nav-products/nav-contact scrolls smoothly to #nosotros/#servicios/#productos/#contacto with window.scrollY progressing 0 -> 1000 -> 2278 -> 3515 -> 4471 and each section landing at ~80px offset from viewport top (matches Lenis offset -80). PDF: GET /catalogo-cikala-2026.pdf returns HTTP 200 with content-type application/pdf and content-length 4214121. products-cta is an <a> with href='/catalogo-cikala-2026.pdf' and download attribute. 4 product cards render with images naturalWidth=848 (all loaded). Language toggle switches all content (hero: 'Abastecemos la gastronomía que mueve al mundo' -> 'We supply the gastronomy that moves the world'; nav labels ES->EN). Contact form POST /api/contact -> 200, success toast '¡Gracias! Tu solicitud fue recibida...' appears, all fields cleared after submit.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS: allow_credentials=True with wildcard allow_origins is invalid per spec; browsers reject credentialed requests. Currently no credentials are sent so no functional impact, but should be tightened for production.
No rate limiting / spam protection on public POST /api/contact.
server.py stores created_at as ISO string in DB but response_model expects datetime; conversion happens on read (works, but native BSON datetime would be cleaner for queries).
seed_data_creation: One TEST_UI_User contact + TEST_<uuid> contact messages inserted during tests; safe to purge.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Lenis smooth-scroll is initialized in App.js and exposed at window.__lenis; scrollToId(id) uses window.__lenis.scrollTo(target, {offset:-80}). Product images are static emergentagent CDN URLs. PDF served from frontend/public/catalogo-cikala-2026.pdf. Contact API at /api/contact (POST/GET).
